$comment:
THE SCRIPT — every word the film shows, and the only place copy is authored.

Nine stations, ids fixed: interior · pair · drawing · facts · note · lineage · wall ·
sentence · mark. Components read this file; they never hold a sentence of their own. A
string that reaches the screen without passing through here has no clearance row, and
`capture/verify-copy.mjs` fails the build on it (CLAUDE.md law 1).

THE FILM IS SILENT. It briefly had an ElevenLabs voiceover; that was removed on
2026-09-08 because the key those takes were generated on was a free tier, and ElevenLabs'
free plan carries no commercial licence — with the clause that content created outside a
paid subscription, BEFORE OR AFTER, cannot be used commercially. Upgrading later would
not have licensed what already existed. See docs/decisions.md D11.

So these lines are on SCREEN, not spoken. That changes how they must be written: a line
that reads well aloud is usually too long to read at a glance while a camera is moving
past it. Every line here is deliberately shorter than the sentence it came from, and the
longer halves were cut rather than wrapped. The picture says the rest.

`note` HAS NO CARD, AND THAT IS THE POINT. Its text is the product's own review pin,
quoted verbatim and rendered as the artifact it is. The film's one honesty beat is a thing
you read in passing, not a claim the film makes in its own voice (docs/decisions.md D1).
Do not write a card for it.

`wall` HAS NO CARD EITHER, for a different reason. The sixth station is a wall of sixty
plans and it is deliberately silent: no card, no number, no score. The rasters are
offline-eval output, and B10 forbids presenting that eval as a public benchmark. The only
honest treatment is to show the volume and say nothing. Do not "fix" the gap.

NO TIMING LIVES HERE. `src/stations.ts` owns every duration, in seconds, and
`src/timeline.ts` is the only file that converts them to frames (CLAUDE.md law 3).

`lines` are AUTHORED LINE BREAKS, rendered `nowrap`. The same sentence breaks in different
places at 1080 and at 1920 wide, so a bad break must surface as an overflow failure rather
than reflow silently. Keep the longest line short enough to survive 1080.

Every line here is registered, byte-identically and in backticks, in docs/copy-clearance.md
with the approved source it came from. Change a character here and the gate goes red until
the row changes too — deliberately: the line nobody cleared is the line that slips.

lines: Refine it by talking to it.
Three bedrooms, open kitchen and living,
Get a real, dimensioned floor plan.
Pay only when you get a plan worth keeping.
A concept plan to take to a professional —

quotes.$comment: NOT OURS. The product's own words, read off archcanvas-promo-video/capture/assets/videos/c06-review-pins.mp4 and confirmed against the 1828x1016 still cut from the raw take at t=286s. Transcribe, never rewrite. It belongs to the filmed session's own 4-room, 108.00 m2 drawing and to no other — plan-family-house has a Bath AND a Laundry, plan-hero has a Bathroom, and capture/verify-numbers.mjs fails the build if this pin is put beside either.
quotes.body: The 110m² plan provides no bathroom, laundry, or dedicated storage.
